column1: # Optional Ash Jenna coda: after Venus Lighthouse, if Isaac met her in Tolbi. The main ending remains unchanged.

column3: I came to watch the\nVenus beacon.\nI saw it burn.{end_wait}
The lighthouse broke.\n{actor_name:7} fell. {actor_name:5}\njumped after her.{end_wait}
And you don't know\nif they survived?{end_wait}
No. We have to find\nout what happened.{end_wait}
Even now, you go\nlooking for someone\nyou may not find.{end_wait}
I'd rather search\nthan leave them behind.{end_wait}
I waited for that\nlight to prove I\nwas right about him.{end_wait}
Yes. I still believe\nhe let my world die.{page_break}But believing isn't\nproof, is it?{end_wait}
No. And what happened\nhere doesn't tell us\nwhat happened there.{end_wait}
I asked you to bear\nan answer I couldn't\nfind myself.{end_wait}
I said I'd help you\nfind out.{page_break}I still mean to,\nwhen I can.{end_wait}
I never promised\nto follow you.{page_break}But I won't dismiss\nwhat you told us.{end_wait}
You have {actor_name:6} and\nKraden to find.\nGo after them.{end_wait}
And the others who\nfell at Venus.{end_wait}
I know.{page_break}I'll look for proof,\nnot someone to blame.{end_wait}
If you find proof,\nI hope you'll let\nus know.{end_wait}
I'll try.{page_break}And, {actor_name:1}... don't\nmistake me for her.{end_wait}
I won't. And I\nwon't give up on\nfinding her.{end_wait}
